title: evaluator's out
description: What an evaluator gives as it ends: its result, its last message, and its Answers.

result.description: The fixed word it gives by running python3 ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/lane/result.py evaluator done, once it has answered each necessary condition of its group.

reply.description: Nothing more than that it's done, as its Answers hold its judgment.

answers.description: The Answers, in the file that its run value answers names: each necessary condition of its group in good, with the lines of the deliverable that meet it, or in more, with good_when.

question.description: The necessary condition, by its ID.

lines.description: Each line of the deliverable that meets it, as it stands, so that a reader checks the answer by reading them.

question.description: The necessary condition, by its ID.

good_when.description: What the deliverable's people get once it's good, in their terms, never how to make it, as the generator holds the sources and mends it in its own way.
